title: Shenzhen PDF Reader — Document AI, Markdown and PDF for Mac
description: Native Mac PDF reader with document AI, cited answer cards, Markdown diagrams, document search, tab groups, local version history, OCR and offline translation.
lede: PDF, Markdown, EPUB, code and images. Document AI with citations and answer cards. Native rendering, tab groups and local version history.
requirements: Apple Silicon · macOS 12 or later · Signed & notarized
screenshot_alt: Two documents compared in chat, with source citations and a 24-month answer card beside the source PDF
caption: Document comparison with an answer card and View evidence. Scripted UI example using fictional plans.
feature1: Compare documents, inspect page images and open cited passages. Generate summaries, tags and missing chapters. Save and organize chats.
feature2: Paginated Markdown with native vector diagrams, math, tables and syntax highlighting. Configurable paper, margins and page breaks.
feature3: Type to search. Results show chapter context, page highlights and map markers. ⌘K searches open documents and Collection.
workspace: Colored groups and saved window layouts. Local copies, revision comparison and editable copies when originals disappear. Dynamic, fixed or unlimited storage.
groups_alt: Shenzhen PDF Reader with colored document groups and a compact sidebar
formats_description: PDF, EPUB, Markdown, plain text, supported source languages and images. HTML opens as source. Local OCR creates searchable PDFs; offline translation uses Argos Translate.
a1: The reader is free and open source. Reading, local history, OCR and translation do not require an account. Optional AI uses your OpenRouter account and paid credits.
a2: Reading, Collection, OCR and translation run locally. Optional AI sends retrieved document content to OpenRouter and its provider; chat and automatic analysis can be disabled separately. Credentials stay in macOS Keychain. Linked document images and update checks can use the network.
a3: The download above is the signed, notarized macOS app for Apple Silicon. A GTK4 Linux frontend is also available in the project. The Windows frontend is in development and has no published binary.
q4: Can an AI agent control the reader?
a4: The local CLI/MCP interface supports document inspection, tab-group organization and Markdown layout. In-app chat also supports selected reader actions with guarded Undo/Redo.
download_info: Latest stable macOS release. Signed, notarized and verified by the built-in updater.
footer: Shenzhen PDF Reader is also known as ShenzhenPDF. Inspired by SumatraPDF; a separate project, not affiliated with it. This website uses no analytics or third-party fonts.
markdown_text: Native page layout and vector rendering. External edits reload automatically; export uses the same document layout.
markdown_alt: Native Markdown document with a vector diagram and table, including macOS window controls
search_text: Page highlights, chapter-grouped results and a full-document map.
search_alt: PDF search results with contextual matches, page highlights and document map, including macOS window controls
ai_notice: AI requires OpenRouter credits and sends retrieved content to the provider. Models can misinterpret documents; verify the evidence.
